sn46.39:1.1: Santi bhikkhave mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānaṃ ajjhārūhā || ye hi rukkhā ajjhāruḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti || || 3.
sn46.39:1.2: Katame ca bhikkhave mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānam ajjhārūhā ye hi rukkhānam ajjhārūḷhā obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti || || Seyyathīdam
sn46.39:1.3: assattho nigrodho pilakkho udumbaro kacchako kapitthako || ||
sn46.39:1.4: Ime kho te bhikkhave mahārukkhā aṇubījā mahākāyā rukkhānam ajjhārūhā ye hi rukkhā ajjhārūḷha obhaggavibhaggā vipatitā senti || || 4.
sn46.39:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco kulaputto yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anāgāriyam pabbajito hoti || so tādisakehi vā kāmehi tato vā pāpiṭṭhatarehi obhaggavibhaggo vipatito seti || || 5.
sn46.39:2.1: Pañcime bhikkhave āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhārūhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā || ||
sn46.39:2.3: Kāmacchando bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhārūho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo || ||
sn46.39:2.4: Byāpādo bhikkhave āvaraṇo nīvaraṇo cetaso ajjhārūho paññāya dubbalīkaraṇo || ||
sn46.39:2.5: Thīnamiddham bhikkhave āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ cetaso ajjhārūham paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ || ||
sn46.39:2.6: Uddhaccakukkuccam bhikkhave āvaraṇam nīvaraṇam cetaso ajjhārūhaṃ paññāya dubbalīkaraṇaṃ || ||
sn46.39:2.7: Vicikicchā bhikkhave āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā ajjhārūhā paññaya dubbalīkaraṇā || ||
sn46.39:2.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca āvaranā nīvaraṇā cetaso ajjhārūhā paññāya dubbalīkaraṇā || || 6.
sn46.39:3.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhārūhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti ||
sn46.39:3.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anajjhārūho bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || la [pe] || || Upekhāsambojjaṅgo bhikkhave anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anajjārūho bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati || ||
sn46.39:3.4: Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anajjhārūhā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjavimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvatta tī
